nom: Report a defect and test from the app
resume: A button in the project's own app to report a defect on the part of the page that is wrong, and a panel to test the stories waiting on int: tick their criteria, record the steps, validate. Everything goes to La Fabrique through the project's server, never from the browser.
apporte: A « Report a defect » flow: pick the part of the page, two lines, an optional screenshot; the issue is opened in the person's name, with page, version, component, screen, browser and recent errors
« What it is about »: the release notes on int then released, a change or a story to choose

A discreet launcher (Report a defect, Test) and a floating « Test » panel for a tester, kept from one page to the next: the stories waiting on the test environment, their criteria to tick, Validate, Fail with a feedback on the story, a defect reported on it
Recording what the tester does for a criterion (pages, buttons, field names, never a value typed), kept as steps and shown as a Gherkin scenario
Reports kept on the device while offline, sent when the network is back

demande.description: Copy fabrique-report.js, fabrique-report.css and fabrique-report-early.js into the app and serve them yourself (application.kit in .fabrique.json: Setup proposes the updates)

A generic relay on the project's server (protocol 2): GET says what the person can do, GET or POST ?path= is passed to La Fabrique with the person's token and the environment, version and deployment headers
The app registered in La Fabrique (Setup > Connected app), scopes defects:report and stories:test; tokens kept on the server only

In .fabrique.json, who may report from each environment (signalement: "equipe" or "comptes", production included when the project says so), and the test environment (recette: int, or production for a project without int); each version path answering the same environnement
script-src 'self' and connect-src 'self' are enough: the browser talks only to the project's server
